notes: Fixes a freeze introduced yesterday. The new server pre-fill checked the local cache one share at a time, which is invisible on a 60-share prepare and about 4,400 round trips when preparing everything - the app sat still for all of it before a single request went out. It now reads the whole cache in one pass, writes each downloaded batch in parallel, waits 25 seconds rather than 60 for a slow batch, and gives up on the server route after two failed batches instead of grinding through every one. Shares already downloaded today are skipped entirely, so a second prepare asks the server for almost nothing.
